title: The Cisco Kid
paragraphs: Cisco and Pancho ride the Southwest confronting outlaws and helping people in trouble, represented here mainly by the Jack Mather and Harry Lang syndicated run plus a rare earlier network broadcast.
Western adventure series derived from O. Henry’s Cisco Kid property.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Mutual network era (October 2, 1942 to February 14, 1945) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], Regional Mutual-Don Lee revival (January 1, 1946 to December 31, 1946) on [[org|org.50630574777d6937|Don Lee Network]], Ziv prerecorded syndication production (January 1, 1947 to December 31, 1956) on [[org|org.87e6f64937f0bfb8|KHJ]], and Post-production syndicated airings (January 1, 1957 to June 24, 1958).

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Harry Lang (performer), Jack Mather (performer), Herb Butterfield (performer), Lou Krugman (performer), Barton Yarborough (performer), Herb Vigran (performer), and Bill Bouchey (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.50630574777d6937|Don Lee Network]], [[org|org.87e6f64937f0bfb8|KHJ]], [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], [[org|org.070a5b7dde24b155|Ziv]], and [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]].
The stories often return to sheriffs, law and frontier justice, guns, shootings and armed violence, robbery and theft, gold, mining and prospecting, ranching and cattle, and outlaws and banditry.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes O. Henry outlaw transformed into heroic Cisco Kid franchise, Postwar prerecorded transcription syndication, and Mexican/Latino Western hero in mid-century popular radio.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|escape|Escape]], and [[show|the-line-up|The Line Up]].
